question: Indicating to a woman, a man said, "Her father is the only son of my father, "How is the man related to the woman?
solution:
Indicating to a women, a man said, "Her father is the only son my father,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1623a0afd2d44ade90e30025121afec6ccfc15f9a711aa95bb59836fe741842.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ded6fdbe2e02cc67cb3e8184a7b161fb1b8736072fb03dc6edba6fb0b104b4a0.png] 

Man is the father of woman.

Hence, **"Father"** is the correct answer.
